shortBio.en: Deep Purple Mark II scream; brief Black Sabbath vocal on Born Again (1983).
shortBio.zh: Deep Purple Mark II 尖叫；1983《Born Again》短暂任 Black Sabbath 人声。

whyHub.en: Deep Purple ↔ Black Sabbath vocal bridge via the Born Again year.
whyHub.zh: 经 Born Again 一年的 Deep Purple ↔ Black Sabbath 人声桥。

body.en:
Born 1945. Mark II vocal on Child in Time and Highway Star. Leaves Purple 1973; sings Black Sabbath’s Born Again (1983); returns to Purple reunions. Scream sits above Lord’s Hammond without melisma fashion.

Citation eras: 1969–73 Mark II, then the one-album Sabbath hitch.
body.zh:
1945 年生。Mark II 人声见于 Child in Time 与 Highway Star。1973 离 Purple；唱 Black Sabbath《Born Again》（1983）；后回 Purple 重聚。尖叫坐在 Lord Hammond 上，不走花腔时尚。

引用期：1969–73 Mark II，再加 Sabbath 一张专的挂靠。

note.zh: 仅 Born Again 专辑/巡演。
